steps.label: Prompt
steps.text:
Make a 15-second ad for [your product], 16:9 at 1920x1080, from the "23-caption-app-promo" template in lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates (MIT, rendered with HyperFrames).

Setup: clone https://github.com/lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates into ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates, then run `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 doctor` and fix anything it reports (it needs Node.js 22 or newer, FFmpeg and Chrome).

The film, scene by scene:
1. a clip with a 'Generate edit' button; the cursor clicks it
2. the clip splits into Before and After cards (motion blur); the After card gets a tracking frame and word-by-word captions, over three clips
3. the logo wipes in large over the cards, then the scene blurs away
4. a hand holds a phone with a grid of caption styles; it scrolls and one style is picked
5. the edit runs on a phone at a garden party: chips for captions, b-roll and music turn from working to done, then 'Done!'
6. four quick cuts of finished edits on phones lying on tables
7. a wall of four creator clips, each with its own caption style
8. the icon pops in, wobbles, moves left and the wordmark and store line fade in

Before you change anything, learn [your product] from [your product URL] and ask me only for what you cannot find: its name, what it does in one line, the copy each scene needs, and two or three brand colours as #rrggbb. It uses 11 photos: ask me for my own, or for permission to keep the demo images. The demo brand, names, prices, numbers, ratings and quotes are placeholders: replace every one with something true for my product, or remove it. Never ship a made-up number or testimonial.

Then:
1. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/new-video.mjs 23-caption-app-promo my-video`
2. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video` to list the variables.
3. Write values.json, keeping each value close to its default's length and format (the same number of |-separated items, plain numbers where the default is a number), then apply it with `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video values.json`.
4. `cd my-video && npx hyperframes@0.8.96 snapshot --at 1,5,10,14`, look at every frame, and fix any text that overflows or any colour that is hard to read.
5. `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 render -f 60 -q high -w 4 -o out.mp4`, then watch it through once before you hand it over.

Template notes: To swap a phone photo: generate one with a flat green screen, run `python3 tools/screen_quad.py photo.png assets/img/name.webp` (THR=100,35 for darker greens), and paste the printed corners into QB, QC or QD in index.html. The picker, the editor and the creator captions are plain HTML/CSS, so restyling them is a CSS edit. The picked style must be one of the names in `styles`. Credits used for the demo: 8 gpt-image-2.5 images (24) + 3 z-image (3) = 27.
